SELECT 'rows' k, COUNT(*) a, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) b, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) c, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) d, MIN(sale_date) e, MAX(sale_date) f
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fmt_variation', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT store_id), 0, 0, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'staff/test', SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), NULL, NULL
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

WITH w AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, SUM(f.quantity) u
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) net, SUM(receipts) rc, SUM(units_sold) u FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 AND store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(w.store_id,r.store_id) id, w.net, r.net, round(w.net-r.net,2) dnet, w.rc, r.rc, w.u, r.u
FROM w FULL JOIN r ON w.store_id=r.store_id
WHERE w.net IS NULL OR r.net IS NULL OR abs(w.net-r.net)>0.5 OR w.rc<>r.rc
ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id, cs.format, SUM(f.net_amount) rnet, MIN(f.net_amount) minl, MIN(f.quantity) minq
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
 GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT format, COUNT(*) receipts, ROUND(SUM(rnet),2) net, ROUND(SUM(rnet)/COUNT(*),2) atv, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) stores, MAX(rnet) maxr, MIN(rnet) minr, SUM(CASE WHEN rnet<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, MIN(minl) minline, MIN(minq) minqty
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) receipts_checked,
 SUM(CASE WHEN staff_mixed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mixed_staff,
 SUM(CASE WHEN n_stores>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_store,
 SUM(CASE WHEN n_dates>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_date,
 SUM(CASE WHEN has_test THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) receipts_with_test
FROM (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, MIN(CAST(f.staff_purchase_flag AS INT))<>MAX(CAST(f.staff_purchase_flag AS INT)) staff_mixed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) n_stores, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) n_dates, MAX(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 has_test
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900
 GROUP BY 1)
